blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 87 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (October 30, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: HLF & CRL lead 87 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 25 Canadian and 62 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of October 30, 2026) found 87 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 25 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 15 of them new to the list this week. High Liner Foods Incorporated (HLF) leads with a +99% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 15 names.

In the U.S., 62 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 22 of them new to the list this week. Charles River Laboratories International Inc. (CRL) leads with a +106% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 24 names.
